findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The manual ware washing station was set up in the incorrect order. The sinks were as followed: wash, sanitize, rinse. The correct setup was discussed with the owner to ensure that dishes are getting cleaned properly. Sanitation should always be the last step of cleaning to be sure that the correct contact times are being met.
findings.citation_text: 4-703.11(A) Hot Water and Chemical. After being cleaned, equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be sanitized in: (A) Hot water manual operations by immersion for at least 30 seconds and as specified under § 4-501.111.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events.
findings.comment: On arrival there is not a procedure available for cleaning up vomit/diarrheal events. A new copy of the procedure given by this department was distributed to correct.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: On arrival the CL based sanitizer in the unit are far to strong for safe use around food. The solution was diluted during this inspection to acceptable levels to correct.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution available for use. Sanitizer solution was made during inspection and tested at 200 ppm Cl-

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed container of cooked pork temp at 125F. Pork was placed on stovetop, and reheated to 165F. 

3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed utensils used for chicken in smoker to be stored on top of smoker and keg next to smoker. Utensils were moved during inspection. 

3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-702.11: UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning. 
Observed operator wipe out crock with a towel. Operator was going to add food to crock directly after wiping it with the towel. Opportunity was taken to discuss with the operator the importance of properly cleaned and sanitized food contact surfaces. Operator put crock through 3 part wash process which was already properly set up.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above. 
Observed a portion of curry and a portion of red beans and rice to be below 135F. This is likely due to the food being cooked and transported without hot holding unit in the truck. Food temperature was raised to 165F and then held properly. Food will be served or discarded by six o’clock tonight. Suggest using coolers or hot box for transporting hot food items in order to maintain them at proper holding temperatures.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P). (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC.

Observed no employee health reporting agreements. Provided copy. Signed. COS.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Reference 2-501.11.

Observed no vomit/diarrheal policy for Norovirus. Provided copy. Facility has bleach to perform procedure. COS.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-204.11: (A)-(B): Chemical SANITIZERS applied for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall meet regulatory requirements.

Observed incorrect bleach - no for food contact surfaces. Discussed with PIC. Inspector will follow-up on 8/10/21.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

Observed no bleach test strips. Only for quat. Provided samples. COS. Ensure to buy test strips.
